meta.title: dsh-liangTime
meta.description: Shows whether DeepSeek API pricing is currently in its peak or off-peak window. The badge sits above the sidebar account button or at the right of the titlebar, and its text and color are configurable in Settings > LiangTime. Peak/off-peak hours are synced from the DeepSeek API pricing page at startup; the settings page also offers a 24-hour timeline, manual intervals, and a one-day override.
